row.Title: GreenTEC Pro CF – Carbon Composite Material for Performance | Extrudr
row.Source note: The exact product's page, saved by the gap-fill research of 2026-09-28 and staged from that copy by digest (b40). Only the print setting its profile names was taken; the page's other statements are unread here. Reviewed by Claude, an agent.

row.Composition / filler: The composite material contains 10% carbon fibre (p. 1, as the sheet states it) "Biobasiernede Charge auf PLA-Basis, enthält Copolyester und Additive." (D-EXTRUDR-GREENTEC-PRO-CF-MSDS-DE, p. 1)
row.Colour caveat: Properties may vary by colour; use TDS scope
row.Selected-grade rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Identified on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), under PLA family-CF, polymer not stated: PLA-based, with a copolyester, "Biobasiernede Charge auf PLA-Basis, enthält Copolyester und Additive." (D-EXTRUDR-GREENTEC-PRO-CF-MSDS-DE, p. 1). Extrudr's German safety data sheet (as printed, "Biobasiernede"): PLA-based with a copolyester, and 10 % carbon fibre by its sheet. The English edition of 18.11.2024 omits PLA. Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
row.Diameter compatibility: Check 1.75 mm variant; diameter is not part tolerance
